bibl.title: Bidirectional optogenetic control of inhibitory neurons in freely-moving mice

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: method
span.quote: Methods: We developed a lens-free approach for constructing dual-color headmounted, fiber-based optical units: any two wavelengths can be combined.

span.label: bidirectional optogenetic control of individual inhibitory neurons in freely-moving mice
span.quote: Conclusion: Using these devices, the same cortical PV cell could be activated and silenced.

span.label: system-or-tool-building
span.quote: Here, we present a novel design for a dual-color, headmounted, fiber-optic based device combined with recording electrodes.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Choosing an inhibitory (PV) opsin-expressing cell reverses the sign of the expected synaptic side-effect, so any blue-light-driven rate increase in the tagged cell must come from direct illumination rather than from trans-synaptic drive
span.quote: when the opsin-expressing cell is inhibitory, synaptic effects are reversed and any rate increase following blue light illumination stems from direct illumination (with the caveat of disynaptic dis-inhibition).

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Optically driven PV cells inhibit their postsynaptic pyramidal partners, so activating the PV cell lowers pyramidal firing and silencing it raises pyramidal firing
span.quote: These observations are consistent with inhibitory synaptic connections between the optically manipulated PV cells and the putative PYR

span.label: With excitatory-cell expression, a non-illuminated opsin-free neuron may inherit a rate increase or decrease through glutamatergic connections from directly illuminated pre-synaptic neurons - which is why the inhibitory-cell design reverses the sign and makes the inference possible.
span.term: a recorded neuron can inherit a rate change it never received light for
span.quote: a nonilluminated/opsin-free recorded neuron may inherit a rate increase/decrease via glutamatergic connections from directlyilluminated, opsin-expressing pre-synaptic neurons

span.label: Each dual-color unit takes about six hours of manual assembly.
span.note: what this limits: any plan to build these at scale: ASSEMBLING A SINGLE DUAL-COLOR OPTICAL UNIT REQUIRES ABOUT SIX HOURS OF WORK
span.quote: The main disadvantage of the presented approach is assembly duration: assembling a single dual-color optical unit requires about six hours of work.

span.label: Unit weight over 0.5 g caps how many can be mounted on a small animal.
span.note: what this limits: how many units a small animal can carry: EACH UNIT WEIGHS OVER 0.5 g
span.quote: A second limitation is the size of the unit: although lighter than optical tables by four or five orders of magnitude, each unit weighs over 0.5 g.

span.label: Only a fraction of PV interneurons expressed both opsins, so not all blue-responsive cells were also red-responsive.
span.note: what this limits: the bidirectional control claim for the population: A THIRD LIMITING FACTOR IS THE PERCENTAGE OF PV INTERNEURONS WITH DOUBLE EXPRESSION OF BOTH CaMKII AND JAWS
span.quote: A third limiting factor is the percentage of PV interneurons with double expression of both CaMKII and Jaws.

span.label: The inference from a rate increase to direct illumination carries a named exception, and it is stated inside the sentence the conclusion is drawn from.
span.note: what this limits: reading a light-evoked rate increase in an inhibitory cell as direct activation: the paper states this holds with the caveat of disynaptic dis-inhibition
span.quote: any rate increase following blue light illumination stems from direct illumination (with the caveat of disynaptic dis-inhibition

span.label: The design space is bounded by what is commercially available and by the physical envelope, not by what the experiment would ideally need.
span.note: what this limits: the wavelengths and powers available in this device: the diodes were chosen to fit a 3.8 mm can, a 100 mA maximal current limitation and low threshold currents
span.quote: The physical requirements were met using ø3.8 mm Transistor Outline (TO) can LDs. To maximize the dynamic range of the light output, we chose LDs that can operate within the maximal current limitation of 100 mA and have low threshold currents.

span.label: The design space was bounded by the model before it was bounded by experiment: butt-coupling was excluded on modelled grounds, so the reported geometry is the survivor of a simulated elimination rather than a measured comparison.
span.quote: the results of the predictive model indicated that a butt-coupling solution [15] cannot be extrapolated to the dual-source case simply by angling one or both of the diodes

span.label: The simple astigmatic Gaussian beam model, a solution of the paraxial Helmholtz equation from laser-beam physics, is imported to predict coupling efficiency and set the optical pathway lengths of the implantable neural device.
span.quote: Like the Gaussian beam model, the SAG model is a solution of the paraxial Helmholtz equation.

span.label: disynaptic dis-inhibition
span.quote: any rate increase following blue light illumination stems from direct illumination (with the caveat of disynaptic dis-inhibition

span.label: predictive model
span.quote: To test the feasibility of several alternative optical designs, a predictive model was devised.

span.label: laser diode
span.quote: we chose LDs that can operate within the maximal current limitation of 100 mA and have low threshold currents.

span.label: ChR2
span.quote: a nonilluminated/opsin-free recorded neuron may inherit a rate increase/decrease via glutamatergic connections from directlyilluminated, opsin-expressing pre-synaptic neurons

span.label: rate increase
span.quote: as PVcells, based on a rate increase during 50 ms blue light pulses (p<0.01, Poisson test) or a rate decrease during 200 ms light pulses

span.label: evidence of direct optogenetic activation - a rate increase after blue light, whose interpretation REVERSES depending on whether the opsin-expressing cell is excitatory or inhibitory
span.quote: when the opsin-expressing cell is inhibitory, synaptic effects are reversed and any rate increase following blue light illumination stems from direct illumination

span.label: feasibility - established by a PREDICTIVE MODEL of alternative optical designs before any unit was built, so the design was selected against a model rather than against measurements
span.quote: To test the feasibility of several alternative optical designs, a predictive model was devised.

span.label: rate increase - evidence of DIRECT illumination only because the illuminated cell is inhibitory, so the synaptic route would lower the rate; the one surviving alternative, disynaptic dis-inhibition, is named as a caveat
span.quote: when the opsin-expressing cell is inhibitory, synaptic effects are reversed and any rate increase following blue light illumination stems from direct illumination (with the caveat of disynaptic dis-inhibition)

span.label: extends → the authors' earlier GRIN-lens waveguide dual-color device (references [16], [17])
span.quote: We have recently reported such an advance [16], [17], but that approach was tailored to specific wavelengths (405 and 638 nm), required custom-made parts (e.g. GRIN lenses), utilized a full nanofabrication facility, and was applied only to head-fixed anesthetized animals.

span.label: extends → previous demonstrations of activating and silencing the same neuron in brain slices, a head-fixed mouse and a freely-moving rat (references [8], [26], [16], [15])
span.quote: This is not the first time that the same neuron is both activated and silenced optically: previous demonstrations were in brain slices [8], [26], in a head-fixed mouse [16], and in a freely-moving rat [15].

span.label: rate increase —distinct-from→ disynaptic dis-inhibition
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.9 — THE PAPER NAMES THE CONFOUND IN THE SENTENCE THAT MAKES THE INFERENCE. Choosing an INHIBITORY cell reverses the expected synaptic sign, so a rate increase after blue light can only be direct illumination - 'with the caveat of disynaptic dis-inhibition'. The design turns a confound into a signature, and the one route that survives is stated in the same breath rather than left to a reader.
span.quote: when the opsin-expressing cell is inhibitory, synaptic effects are reversed and any rate increase following blue light illumination stems from direct illumination (with the caveat of disynaptic dis-inhibition)

span.label: rate increase —operationalised-as→ ChR2
span.note: differs in: PULSE DURATION DECIDES WHICH DIRECTION COUNTS AS EVIDENCE: a rate increase during 50 ms pulses and a rate DECREASE during 200 ms pulses both tag a cell as PV. The same cell class is identified by opposite signs of the same measure, separated only by how long the light was on · strength of the relation: 0.8
span.quote: as PVcells, based on a rate increase during 50 ms blue light pulses (p<0.01, Poisson test) or a rate decrease during 200 ms light pulses

span.label: predictive model —operationalised-as→ laser diode
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.8 — FEASIBILITY WAS SETTLED BEFORE ANYTHING WAS BUILT, and the model's job was to RULE DESIGNS OUT: it 'indicated that a butt-coupling solution cannot be extrapolated to the dual-source case simply by angling one or both of the diodes'. The published device is what survived a modelled elimination.
span.quote: To test the feasibility of several alternative optical designs, a predictive model was devised. Light output from each LD was modeled as an astigmatic Gaussian beam according to four parameters: LD wavelength (𝜆), light output power (𝑃), and the horizontal and vertical divergent angles

span.label: Mann-Whitney U test
span.quote: Thus, blue light induced stronger effects than red light

span.label: binomial test
span.quote: These numbers are higher than expected by chance (1%; p<0.001, exact Binomial test).

span.label: Poisson test
span.quote: based on a rate increase during 50 ms blue light pulses (p<0.01, Poisson test) or a rate decrease during 200 ms light pulses (p<0.01, Poisson test)

span.label: effect size
span.quote: The effect size for these units was h= 0.61±0.04 (mean ± standard error of the mean).

span.label: principal component analysis
span.quote: waveforms were linearly detrended, projected onto a common basis obtained by principal component analysis of the data, and sorted automatically

span.label: Gaussian mixture model
span.quote: a putative PYR or INT based on a Gaussian-mixture model (p<0.05; [38]).

span.label: confidence bands
span.quote: Monosynaptic connections (highlighted in grey) are determined by crossing of the 99.9% global confidence bands (purple dashed lines).

span.label: mean and standard deviation
span.quote: the impedance of each recording site, measured in 0.9% NaCl at 1 kHz (NanoZ, White Matter), was 1.14±0.11 MΩ (mean±SD over a total of n = 96 recording sites in three probes).

span.label: standard error of the mean
span.quote: The effect size for these units was h= 0.61±0.04 (mean ± standard error of the mean).

span.label: The lens-free dual-color unit delivered 454±271 µW of 450 nm light and 8.65±2.26 mW of 638 nm light at the fiber tip at 100 mA, far above the 100 µW / 1 mW design thresholds.
span.quote: The light power measured at the tip of the fiber at a driving current of 100 mA was 454±271 µW and 8.65±2.26 mW for the 450 nm and 638 nm wavelengths, respectively

span.label: The blue and red illumination fields emerging from the shared multimode fiber overlapped spatially by 46%, a lower bound on the in-brain overlap.
span.quote: Nevertheless, the illumination profiles of two LDs coupled to the same fiber overlapped by 46%

span.label: The two wavelengths did not interact optically: their spectra at the fiber end were separate and no spectral interference occurred during simultaneous dual-color illumination.
span.quote: In contrast, the spectra at the end of the fiber (measured using CCS100 spectrometer, Thorlabs) did not overlap, and there was no spectral interference during dual-color illumination

span.label: Nine of 74 interneurons (12%) were controlled bidirectionally through the same fiber, raising their spike rate under blue light and lowering it under red light.
span.quote: Indeed, some of the units that modulated their activity during blue and red light application also increased their spike rate during blue light and decreased during red light (9/74 of the INT; 12%).

span.label: Blue-light activation produced significantly larger effects than red-light silencing, which the authors attribute to less red light being applied or weaker expression of the red-sensitive opsin.
span.quote: Thus, blue light induced stronger effects than red light

span.label: The second-order effects on pyramidal cells were strictly sign-appropriate for inhibition: no pyramidal cell was excited by blue light and none was suppressed by red light.
span.quote: No PYR increased their firing rate during blue light, and no PYR decreased their firing rates during red light.

span.label: On the freely-moving mouse's head the laser can heated by no more than 7 °C even under prolonged pulsed illumination.
span.quote: We found that heating did not exceed 7 °C even during prolonged illumination (maximal current, 29 mA; pulse duration, 50 ms; duty cycle, 0.6%; Fig. 9A, right).

span.label: Wide-band recordings taken during both blue and red illumination were free of electromagnetic-interference artifacts, so the shielding and grounding worked at the power levels used.
span.quote: Visual inspection of the data recorded during both blue and red illumination in the dual-color mice revealed clean wide-band traces

span.label: The paper claims the first conclusive demonstration that a single identified neuron can be both activated and silenced in a freely-moving animal.
span.quote: Thus the present work shows conclusively, for the first time, that the same neuron can be both activated and silenced in a freely-moving animal.

span.label: The approach's main cost is labour: each dual-color optical unit takes roughly six hours to assemble.
span.quote: The main disadvantage of the presented approach is assembly duration: assembling a single dual-color optical unit requires about six hours of work.

span.label: simple astigmatic Gaussian (SAG) model
span.quote: This profile can be described using the simple astigmatic Gaussian (SAG) model [36].

span.quote: and at multiple intensities above and below that level (log-spaced multiples of Imax; typically 0.5, 1, 2, and 4).

span.quote: During blue LD illumination, some well-isolated units increased their spike rate (36 of 80 INT recorded in neocortex and CA1 of three mice; 45%; see Fig. 6B for an example neocortical unit and Fig. 7A for the population).

span.quote: We therefore monitored the temperature of the LD metal can continuously on head in one mouse.

span.quote: The PV cell firing rate per pulse (center) was calculated for each of 150 blue light pulses (50 ms, 29 mA, 0.6% duty cycle; green line) and 150 epochs with no stimulation intermingled between the stimulation pulses (50 ms, no driving current, dashed green line).

span.label: cell type targeted for opsin expression (held to parvalbumin-immunoreactive inhibitory neurons)
span.term: cell type targeted for opsin expression (held to parvalbumin-immunoreactive inhibitory neurons)
span.quote: To minimize network-induced effects generated by trans-synaptic activation, we chose an inhibitory cell type: parvalbumin-immunoreactive neurons (PV cells).

span.quote: Only well-isolated units (amplitude >50 μV; Lratio <0.05 [40]; interspike interval index <0.2 [41]), were used.

span.quote: The light power measured at the tip of the fiber at a driving current of 100 mA was 454±271 µW and 8.65±2.26 mW for the 450 nm and 638 nm wavelengths, respectively

span.quote: The average unit weighed 630±55 mg (mean±SD).

span.quote: The weight of an implantation-ready device was 2.77 g

span.quote: We recorded a total of 230 well-isolated cells from the neocortex and CA1 of the three mice.

span.quote: During blue LD illumination, some well-isolated units increased their spike rate (36 of 80 INT recorded in neocortex and CA1 of three mice; 45%; see Fig. 6B for an example neocortical unit and Fig. 7A for the population).

span.quote: Indeed, some of the units that modulated their activity during blue and red light application also increased their spike rate during blue light and decreased during red light (9/74 of the INT; 12%).

span.quote: The effect size for these units was h= 0.61±0.04 (mean ± standard error of the mean).

span.label: 7 °C — Maximum on-head temperature rise of the laser can during prolonged illumination in a behaving mouse
span.quote: We found that heating did not exceed 7 °C even during prolonged illumination (maximal current, 29 mA; pulse duration, 50 ms; duty cycle, 0.6%; Fig. 9A, right).

span.label: under 31°C — Peak bench-test temperature of an optical unit under prolonged high-load operation, below mammalian body temperature
span.quote: the peak temperature reached was under 31°C (Fig. 4I), lower than mammalian body temperature

span.label: 1.14±0.11 MΩ — Impedance of each silicon-probe recording site measured at 1 kHz in saline
span.quote: the impedance of each recording site, measured in 0.9% NaCl at 1 kHz (NanoZ, White Matter), was 1.14±0.11 MΩ (mean±SD over a total of n = 96 recording sites in three probes).

span.label: 14.9±5.3 MΩ — Electrical isolation between diode anode-cathode and the grounded Faraday shield, high enough to make EMI negligible
span.quote: The isolation between the anode-cathode and the cage was 14.9±5.3 MΩ (n=8 dual-color units), indicating that EMI would be negligible

span.label: three freely-moving male mice — Number of animals implanted, all heterozygous for PV-Cre and expressing ChR2 and Jaws in PV interneurons
span.quote: To express two opsins, ChR2 [37] and Jaws [28], in parvalbumin-immunoreactive (PV) inhibitory interneurons, three freely-moving male mice were used, all heterozygous for PV-Cre

span.label: about six hours — Assembly time for a single dual-color optical unit, the method's main practical cost
span.quote: The main disadvantage of the presented approach is assembly duration: assembling a single dual-color optical unit requires about six hours of work.
